name: Ahmad bin Jamal
bio:
Ahmad's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for building model airplanes, which then led to an apprenticeship at a local automotive repair shop. He quickly demonstrated a knack for composite materials, excelling in fabrication and repair techniques. His keen eye for detail and commitment to precision caught the attention of Opala Legends, where he now plays a crucial role in ensuring the structural integrity and aerodynamic efficiency of their race cars.

He is particularly adept at diagnosing composite failures and developing innovative repair solutions. Ahmad prides himself on staying up-to-date with the latest advancements in composite technology, constantly seeking ways to improve the performance and durability of the team's vehicles. His methodical approach and unwavering dedication make him a valuable asset to Opala Legends, particularly during demanding race weekends.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: Ahmad is of average height with a lean build, often seen wearing his team's uniform.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Insists on using a specific brand of epoxy resin, claiming it provides superior bonding.
Has a habit of humming quietly while working on intricate composite repairs.
